escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read/Execution (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.reason: Remote code execution in dev environment — CVSS 9.8, AV:N, no auth required

escalations.title: gRPC Certificate Validation Bypass (Platform Orchestrator)
escalations.reason: Certificate authentication bypass allows unauthorized gRPC calls to platform orchestrator

escalations.title: React Router Open Redirect via Protocol-Relative URL
escalations.reason: Routing layer open redirect enables phishing attacks

p1_findings.title: Canonical platform spec (~85 FRs) entirely unimplemented — domain pivot not retired
p1_findings.detail: 85 FRs in Specifications/ have zero Verifies: references in Source/. Domain pivot from dev-workflow-platform to workflow-engine occurred without retiring the stale spec.
p1_findings.recommendation: Move dev-workflow-platform.md to docs/archive/ if superseded, or add PLANNED status marker. Canonicalize which spec is authoritative.

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to Specifications/ — false-positive PASSED signal
p1_findings.detail: Enforcer auto-selects Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md (13 FRs) and ignores 95+ FRs in Specifications/. CI treats PASSED as full coverage when it is not.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add --specs-dir Specifications/ mode or update auto-detect logic to scan all Specifications/*.md files.

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search not wired — 5 tests documented as intentionally failing
p1_findings.detail: Test file explicitly documents that the route is not in app.ts. Five tests covering FR-dependency-search fail on every CI run. Violates zero-new-failures gate.
p1_findings.recommendation: Implement Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts and register in app.ts, OR convert tests to test.todo() markers until feature is prioritised.

p1_findings.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read/Execution (CVSS 9.8)
p1_findings.detail: vitest <=2.0.5 — when UI server is accessible, arbitrary files can be read and executed. No authentication required. Affects dev environment.

p1_findings.title: Vitest @vitest/mocker Path Traversal (CVSS 5.9)
p1_findings.detail: vitest/mocker redirect mock can bypass path restrictions, allowing arbitrary file reads. Fixed by upgrading vitest to >=4.1.11.
p1_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Frontend && npm install vitest@^5.0.3 (covers both DEP-001 and DEP-002)

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-* IDs (13 instances) have no backing specification document
p2_findings.detail: Custom requirement IDs invented during implementation — not in any Specifications/ document. Violates specs-first architecture rule.
p2_findings.recommendation: Create Plans/dependency-feature/requirements.md with formal FR definitions.

p2_findings.title: eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without rationale (2 locations)
p2_findings.detail: Lint suppressions with no explanatory comment. Future maintainers cannot distinguish intentional omission from bugs.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add inline comments explaining intentional dependency omissions.

p2_findings.title: Vite Server FS Deny Bypass on Windows (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.detail: server.fs.deny can be bypassed on Windows via alternate path representations.

p2_findings.title: Browserslist Unbounded Memory Growth / OOM DoS (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.detail: No cache eviction causes unbounded memory growth; build/dev server crashes on crafted queries.
p2_findings.recommendation: Resolved by upgrading vite@^6.5.0 (pulls in browserslist >=4.28.7)

p2_findings.title: Browserslist Prototype Pollution via Stats File (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.detail: normalizeStats() can be prototype-polluted by a crafted browserslist-stats.json; causes unhandled crash.

p2_findings.title: Jest Ecosystem High-Severity Vulnerabilities (micromatch ReDoS cascade)
p2_findings.detail: jest 29.7.0 pulls in vulnerable micromatch, causing ReDoS and path traversal risks across @jest/core, runners, reporters.

p2_findings.title: gRPC Certificate Validation Bypass + Server Crash (platform/orchestrator)
p2_findings.detail: Three CVEs: server crash from malformed compressed messages, and certificate validation returning unauthorized certs as authorized.

p2_findings.title: Ws WebSocket Memory Exhaustion DoS (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.detail: ws <8.21.0 can be exhausted by sending many tiny frames, causing OOM in Vite dev server.
p2_findings.recommendation: Resolved by upgrading vite@^6.5.0 (pulls in ws >=8.21.0)

p3_findings.title: Swallowed JSON parse error missing mandatory suppression comment
p3_findings.recommendation: Add: // Intentionally suppress parse error — non-JSON error body; fall back to HTTP status

p3_findings.title: FR-TMP-001–FR-TMP-010 (tiered-merge-pipeline) have zero source Verifies
p3_findings.recommendation: Add Verifies: FR-TMP-* comments in platform/ scripts, or add PLANNED/PLATFORM status marker to spec.

p3_findings.title: React Router Open Redirect via Protocol-Relative URL
@babel/core Arbitrary File Read via SourceMap (CVSS 3.2, local)
baseline-browser-mapping Process Termination on Invalid Input
Vite NTLMv2 Hash Disclosure on Windows (launch-editor)
Backend Dependencies 1-5 Major Versions Behind (express, pino, uuid)
p3_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Backend && npm install express@latest pino@latest uuid@latest (check pino 10.x breaking changes)

p3_findings.title: Frontend Dependencies 1 Major Version Behind (react, react-dom, react-router-dom)
p3_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Frontend && npm install react@19 react-dom@19 react-router-dom@7

p4_findings.title: Large Transitive Dependency Tree (~450 transitive deps)
p4_findings.recommendation: Consider jest→vitest migration to reduce footprint
